subject: pe
title: Zone of Optimal Functioning
welcome_lead: Anxiety, arousal and individual performance zones — Hanin's IZOF.
meta_desc: A-Level PE adventure on IZOF and individualised arousal optimisation.
final_note: Average optimal arousal is a myth — every athlete has their own zone.

concepts.def: Bodily symptoms — sweating, racing heart, tension.
Each athlete's unique anxiety band associated with best performance.
Identifying athlete's optimal positive/negative emotion blend.

walkthroughs.body_html: Different athletes perform best at different anxiety levels — golfer low, sprinter high.
Cognitive anxiety steadily rises pre-event; somatic anxiety peaks at start and falls during play.
Athletes log mood before best/worst performances to identify personal optimal emotional cocktails.

numericals.q: If an athlete's IZOF spans state-anxiety scores 18–24 and their pre-game score is 30, deviation above zone is?
